fusions.name: Stripped to the Stalk
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A swarm strips everything in a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 9 damage with a 40% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plague Hop
fusions.desc: Throws a clot of musk-fed locusts at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 14 damage. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Chewing Haze
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of locusts and musk for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Field Over
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, the swarm moves on to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage, slowing it by 25% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
